==English==

===Etymology===
From {{bor|en|it|padrone}}, from {{uder|en|la|patronus}}. {{doublet|en|patron|Patronus|patroon|pattern}}.

===Noun===
{{en-noun|s|padroni}}

# A [[patron]]; a [[protector]].
# A [[landlord]]; the [[master]] of a large [[estate]].
# The [[master]] of a small [[coaster]] in the [[Mediterranean]].
# A man who [[import]]s, and controls the [[earnings]] of, [[Greek]] or [[Italian]] [[labourer]]s, [[street]] [[musician]]s, [[child]] [[beggar]]s, etc.
# A [[mafia]] [[boss]].
